description: ⚠️ **EXPERIMENTAL — may change or be withdrawn at any time.** Do not build automation on it or persist it as a system of record. Individual prints for one A-share on one trading day, in `seq` order with cursor paging — for inspecting a specific moment; for whole-session work use `trades_minute`. ⚠️ Not exchange tick data: one row is everything traded in a 3-second window, so to find large trades filter on `min_amount` — counting rows will not do it. ⚠️ `side` is inferred from bid/ask (`M` = neither). ⚠️ `seq` may have gaps (backfilled after the close). ⚠️ No 09:25 auction print — never take an open price here. Page with `after_seq` = previous `next_after_seq` until null (a day is ≤3 pages at the default limit). Retention 60 trading days (`retention_from`); coverage starts 2026-06-01.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

after_seq.description: Cursor: only prints with seq greater than this. Use the previous next_after_seq.

code.description: Canonical code of one A-share security (e.g. SSE:600519)

date.description: Trading day YYYY-MM-DD (China time). Omit for the latest day that has data.

from.description: Earliest print time HH:MM (China time), inclusive.

min_amount.description: Keep only prints reaching this turnover in yuan — the way to find large trades.

side.description: B = buyer-initiated, S = seller-initiated, M = neither. Inferred from the book.

to.description: Latest print time HH:MM (China time), inclusive.

name: trades_ticks
